test_procedures: Called the [List organization repositories](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos/repos#list-organization-repositories) endpoint to obtain a list of all repositories.
Saved the API response: orgs/repos.json.
For each repository, inspected the 'private' property to determine whether the setting was set to 'true'.

test_results.test_description: Repositories are configured to require an approval before a pull request is merged.
test_procedures: Called the [List organization repositories](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos/repos#list-organization-repositories) endpoint to obtain a list of all repositories.
Saved the API response: orgs/repos.json.
For each repository, performed the following steps:

- Called the [Get branch protection](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/branches/branch-protection#get-branch-protection) endpoint to obtain the classic branch protection configuration for the repository's default branch.
- Saved the API response: repos/[REPO_NAME]/branch_protection_rules.json.
- Called the [List repository rulesets](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos/rules#list-repository-rulesets) endpoint to obtain the rulesets for each repository.
- Saved the API response: repos/[REPO_NAME]/rulesets.json.
For each repository ruleset, performed the following steps:
- Called the [Get repository ruleset](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos/rules#get-repository-ruleset) endpoint to obtain the ruleset's settings.
- Saved the API response: repos/[REPO_NAME]/rulesets/[RULE_ID].json.

For each repository, inspected the classic branch protection configuration and applicable rulesets to determine whether the default branch required changes to be approved before the pull request can be merged.
